messages.author: e6c87266ffc5f0f2
messages.subject: Any idea why geom_histogram fails?
parts:
ggplot(data.frame(x=1,y=runif(100)),aes(y=y,x=factor(x))) +
geom_histogram()

Should work, shouldn't it? It works with geom_points().

Thanks.

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: Re: Any idea why geom_histogram fails?
parts:
The issue is that by making x a factor, you're really just making a bar chart with one level.

Instead, try the following:

 ggplot(data.frame(x=runif(100)),aes(x)) + geom_histogram()                

If you want instead of frequency the y axis to represent something else, do something like the following:

ggplot(data.frame(x=runif(100),y=rnorm(100,50,1)),aes(x)) + geom_histogram(aes(weight=y))+labs(y="dollars")+scale_y_continuous(formatter="dollar")
